scope: All regular working-tree file paths and contents including ignored/untracked files, excluding .git administration; all locally stored blob/commit/tag/tree objects, including unreachable objects; all fetched advertised heads/tags/pull heads/merge refs. Server caches and backups are not accessible.
identity_source: Authenticated GitHub profile name/email and local account token; values never reported
owner_resolution_options: Ask GitHub Support to purge retained PR 1 identity-bearing refs/objects, then rescan.
Delete and recreate the repository from clean squashed history before going public, then rescan.
publication_rule: Repository MUST remain private until the owner resolves retained history. No force push or history rewrite attempted.
